# Solana Swap API & Router

> Solana swap API and Solana router demo: quote and build token swaps across Pump.fun, Meteora, and Raydium. An alternative to Jupiter and Titan via Vybe.

Live demo of the Vybe Solana API. The linked docs pages are the Markdown versions.

## Demo
- [Solana Swap API & Router](https://solana-swap-api.vybenetwork.com/): Solana swap API and Solana router demo: quote and build token swaps across Pump.fun, Meteora, and Raydium. An alternative to Jupiter and Titan via Vybe.

- [Swap Quote API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_swap_quote_proxy.md)
- [Token Details API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_token_details_v4.md)
- [Token Trade History API](https://docs.vybenetwork.com/reference/get_trade_data_program_v4.md)
